nonblocking_advisories.observation: The general statement that device backups follow backup settings does not explicitly promise imported audio backup; UserSongLibrary.importAudio marks copied audio excluded from backup on a best-effort basis.
nonblocking_advisories.suggested_wording: Device backups follow your backup settings. Timbre marks imported audio copies to be excluded from backups; keep your original recordings separately.
